description: Three provenance figures: active-site motif readout for all E. coli type I sulfatases, gene-neighbourhood comparison with the atsBA precedent, and STRING evidence channel decomposition
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np

# ---------- Figure 1: active-site motif readout (values computed in the preceding cells) ----------
rows = [
 ("AslA  (b3801, E. coli K-12)",  "ILTSAYSQPS","S","SPTR","ATILTG", "Ser", "predicted"),
 ("YdeN  (b1498, E. coli K-12)",  "FTNGYVAHGV","S","GPSR","AAIMTG", "Ser", "predicted"),
 ("YidJ  (b3678, E. coli K-12)",  "FNSAYTCSPV","C","TPAR","AGLFTG", "Cys", "predicted"),
 ("AtsA  (K. pneumoniae)",        "RMSQYYTSPM","S","APAR","SMLLTG", "Ser", "demonstrated"),
 ("AtsA  (P. aeruginosa)",        "RLTDFHTAST","C","SPTR","SMLLTG", "Cys", "demonstrated"),
 ("ARSA  (human)",                "FTDFYVPVSL","C","TPSR","AALLTG", "Cys", "demonstrated"),
]
pos = [136,132,52,72,51,69]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11.5,4.2))
ax.set_xlim(0,30); ax.set_ylim(-0.5,len(rows)-0.3); ax.invert_yaxis(); ax.axis("off")
for i,(lab,left,nuc,rest,right,typ,status) in enumerate(rows):
    seq = left+nuc+rest+right
    for k,ch in enumerate(seq):
        is_nuc = (k==10)
        in_motif = 10 <= k <= 14
        col = ("#B03A2E" if nuc=="C" else "#1A5276") if is_nuc else ("#D6EAF8" if in_motif else "#F4F4F4")
        ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((k+9,i-0.33),0.95,0.66, fc=col, ec="white"))
        ax.text(k+9.47,i,ch,ha="center",va="center",fontsize=8.5,
                color="white" if is_nuc else "#222", fontweight="bold" if in_motif else "normal")
    ax.text(8.6,i,lab,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
    ax.text(40,i,f"{nuc}{pos[i]}  {typ}-type  ({status})",ha="left",va="center",fontsize=9,
            color="#B03A2E" if nuc=="C" else "#1A5276")
ax.set_xlim(0,46)
ax.text(19.5,-0.95,"sulfatase signature (C/S)XPXR",ha="center",fontsize=9,style="italic")
ax.set_title("Active-site residue of every type I sulfatase encoded in E. coli K-12, against sulfatases\n"
             "whose formylglycine is experimentally demonstrated", fontsize=11, loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---------- Figure 2: gene neighbourhood ----------
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3,1, figsize=(11.5,5.0))
cfg = [
 ("E. coli K-12  aslB / aslA  (NC_000913.3)",
  [("aslB",3982958,3984193,+1,"#2E86C1"),("aslA",3984352,3986007,-1,"#CA6F1E")], 158, "convergent, opposite strands"),
 ("E. coli K-12  ydeN / ydeM  (NC_000913.3)",
  [("ydeM",1579633,1580790,-1,"#2E86C1"),("ydeN",1580842,1582524,-1,"#CA6F1E")], 51, "co-oriented, ydeN then ydeM"),
 ("K. pneumoniae  atsB / atsA  (AJ131525), characterised Ser-type precedent",
  [("atsB",623,1810,+1,"#2E86C1"),("atsA",1855,3588,+1,"#CA6F1E")], 44, "co-oriented operon, atsB then atsA"),
]
for ax,(title,genes,gap,note) in zip(axes,cfg):
    lo=min(g[1] for g in genes)-350; hi=max(g[2] for g in genes)+350
    ax.set_xlim(lo,hi); ax.set_ylim(-1,1); ax.axis("off")
    ax.text(lo, 0.78, title, fontsize=9.5, fontweight="bold", va="bottom")
    ax.text(lo, -0.92, f"intergenic spacing {gap} bp, {note}", fontsize=9, color="#555")
    for name,s,e,strand,c in genes:
        w=e-s; head=min(w*0.25,(hi-lo)*0.045)
        if strand>0: ax.arrow(s,0,w-head,0,width=0.28,head_width=0.5,head_length=head,fc=c,ec="none",length_includes_head=True)
        else:        ax.arrow(e,0,-(w-head),0,width=0.28,head_width=0.5,head_length=head,fc=c,ec="none",length_includes_head=True)
        ax.text((s+e)/2,0,name,ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=9.5,fontweight="bold")
    ax.plot([min(g[2] for g in genes), max(g[1] for g in genes)],[0,0],color="#888",lw=1,zorder=0)
plt.suptitle("Genomic context: the aslB-aslA pair does not reproduce the atsB-atsA arrangement", fontsize=11, y=1.0)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---------- Figure 3: STRING evidence channels ----------
chan = ["neighbourhood","phylo. profile","coexpression","experiments","databases","textmining"]
vals = {"aslB - aslA":[0.083,0.665,0.186,0.0,0.0,0.865],
        "ydeM - ydeN":[0.631,0.713,0.637,0.0,0.0,0.627],
        "yidF - yidJ":[0.083,0.539,0.055,0.0,0.0,0.000]}
x=np.arange(len(chan)); w=0.26
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(10,4))
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(vals.items()):
    ax.bar(x+(i-1)*w, v, w, label=k, color=["#CA6F1E","#2E86C1","#7D8C8D"][i])
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(chan); ax.set_ylabel("STRING channel score")
ax.set_title("STRING evidence channels for the three E. coli maturase/sulfatase gene pairs\n"
             "(species 511145; the aslB-aslA link is carried by textmining, the ydeM-ydeN link by neighbourhood and coexpression)",
             fontsize=10, loc="left")
ax.legend(frameon=False); ax.set_ylim(0,1.0)
for s in ("top","right"): ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print("figures rendered")
